subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Progress
solution:
The correct answer is **Development.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word is **Development.**
 
• **Progress** means **moving forward or onward in the direction of a goal**.
 
• Thus the correct synonym would be **Development.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Progress** synonyms are - **forward movement, progression, and advancement.**
 
• **Progress **antonyms are - **regress, deteriorate, and return.**
 
• **Diminishment** meaning is **to undermine someone's standing, respect, or reputation.**
 
• **Halt** meaning is **brought about a sudden halt.**
 
• **Stagnation **meaning is **the absence of motion or flow**.
